dict.string: The microphone is on only while you turn on dictation or talk mode in the chat, so you can speak instead of typing.
Used only when the chat's own transcriber can't be reached: macOS then turns what you say into text, and may send it to Apple to do so.
This is used only when you search your network for model servers or use one, or open an address on your network that you typed yourself.
Files in Documents are opened only when you choose them or a folder that holds them, such as a project to work on.
Files on the Desktop are opened only when you choose them or a folder that holds them, such as a project to work on.
Files in Downloads are opened only when you choose them or a folder that holds them, such as a project to work on.
